source_organization: Inferred grouping from adjacent COP1 translator handlers and floating point register/rounding helpers; original filenames are not retained.

validation.compile: Passed with tracked VC7 /O2 /Ob1 /ML /GL in complete application context; DynarecFPU.cpp emitted no warnings.

semantic_execution.description: Run original and unlinked compiled C++ function bodies in Unicorn; callee hooks record typed emitter/helper calls and selected globals. Original register ABI and candidate cdecl ABI are decoded separately. This semantic diagnostic does not certify linked bytes.
semantic_execution.source_binding: The source hash identifies the current working-tree source. The separately supplied object must be tied to that source by its compilation record; this runner does not compile it.

validation.limitation: All instruction bytes and complete function extents match after real PE relocation fields and external relative branches are normalized. Linked placement is still different. Application identities, interior data operands, source-local controls and literal addresses are not all independently verified; this is not byte-exact EXE certification.

proof_snapshot.scope: Only the FPU source/header are asserted unchanged from this pinned link. Other application translation units and linked placement have since changed. This report does not certify the current complete executable.

notes: Register argument locations are recovered from the original machine code; C++ prototypes expose semantic parameters and LTCG chooses register allocation.
Repeated FR-mode emission guards are represented as macros to retain both conditional emission paths.
C.SF and C.NGLE preserve the original empty emitted exception paths.
Invalid GetFpuRegisterAddress formats report GetCOP1Reg: Error 0 and return zero; FpuRoundingControl invalid formats still emit a load from zero.
0x03E64E80 and 0x03E64E84 are separate mode-change/dynamic-mode DWORD globals; the former provisional CPU_LLAddress64 alias was incorrect.

Source cases and byte casts preserve original VC7 LTCG allocation: explicit GetFpuRegisterAddress return cases and a byte-narrowed FR0 upper-register index restore the original custom ABI and instruction stream.
